channel.title: Poopy and Friends
channel.description: The comic-relief hero with a heart of gold and a smell of pure chaos. Family-made audio episodes: full voice cast, songs, and silliness. New episodes appear automatically.
channel.itunes:author: KinBondJoy Family Studio

item.title: Ep. 1 — The Fun-Freezer 3000
item.description: Dr. Robotnik freezes ALL the fun in town. Sonic bonks, Donkey Kong barrels, and one heroic heap of brown saves the day with the Silly Dance of the Seven Stinkwaves — featuring two brand-new songs, "The Poopy Theme" and "Giggle Storm."

item.title: Ep. 2 — The Perpetual Monday Machine
item.description: A machine that makes every day Monday. Forever. Poopy and the gang fight back with the one weapon Mondays cannot survive: Tuesday energy.

item.title: Ep. 3 — The Fun Permit Office
item.description: Doctor Robotnik tries to permit away all fun with Form 27-B — and drowns in his own self-filing paperwork.

item.title: Ep. 4 — The Robotnik Repeaters
item.description: Eight clones of Doctor Robotnik, one maximum-goof duplication machine, a blanket-fort pizza party, and a ninth Robotnik loose somewhere in town.

item.title: Ep. 5 — The Duck Situation
item.description: Robotnik number nine — the one competent copy — trains forty ducks for Operation Featherstorm, then learns that evil things do not wait for baby ducks stuck in drains. Ten-for-ten giggle confirmed.

item.title: Ep. 6 — The Great Sneak Retirement
item.description: Robotnik number nine has been doing secret good deeds for four days — and a new friend, Momo the museum monkey who sees EVERYTHING, teaches him that sneaking is better with a friend. Plus: three baby ducks, one catastrophic naming error, and a first word nobody was ready for.
